---
title: Add student profiles / manage students
labels:
  - enhancement
---

## Summary

Add explicit student profiles and management support so the app can track student details beyond email only.

## Requirements

- Create a student data model with fields such as email, name, grade, and optionally role.
- Add UI to view student profiles and registrations.
- Allow admin users to manage students (view, edit, remove).

## Notes

This is needed to fully support the admin/student distinction and to match ActivityHub's Manage Students concept.
